scope: Empty-first bounded development validation. Current paired A-E R1/R3 only for model fitting and decisions. Older kong records from different sessions cannot calibrate these paired batches. All data have previously been inspected; internal chronological validation is not a new independent capture.
budget: Retain exact existing 864 distinct packets per arm per run. Six-state 24 cycles x6 states x6 packets, G2 24 batches x36 packets. No reselection. Every model sees identical split and budget in its arm.
split: R1 cycles/batches0:8 establish reference and B; R1 8:16 calibrate an empty-model error envelope only; R1 16:24 evaluate. R3 0:8 fits nuisance coefficients; R3 8:24 evaluates. Evaluation uses disjoint continuous4-cycle blocks. Tone index%3!=2 fits (20 tones); tone%3==2 held out (10 tones,5 in each half-band). Human R2 is not used before empty decisions are frozen.

models.STATIC: No correction; reproduce old PCD and empty drift.
models.NSI: Projected isotropic random-variance model D_w,k = B_k(R_w,k-R_ref,k)B_k approximately u_w B_k beta I B_k.
models.NSD: Projected diagonal chain-variance model D_w,k approximately u_w B_k diag(beta_1,beta_2,beta_3) B_k. Same three real coefficients across30tones; primary physically constrained extension. Neither model is asserted to be measured receiver noise.

observable: u_w=mean_w(90/||raw_packet||_F^2)/mean_R1fit(90/||raw_packet||_F^2)-1. This is a digital normalization-factor proxy, not calibrated RSSI. R1fit and R3fit are split into2-cycle blocks to fit one or three shared real coefficients by least squares on training tones only. Require finite, full-rank design, condition<=1e6 and nonnegative coefficients; negative fits are recorded and rejected, not clipped.
identifiability: The projected model allows dominant-signal compensation along h; pure delta I cannot explain the full trace-constrained normalized covariance. Full covariance affine-scale and oracle projected diagnostics are reported separately and cannot license human correction. Direct target eigenvalue/trace subtraction, fitting a per-target phase offset, and cross-state coherent assembly are forbidden.
empty_gate: For each state/model, evaluate all six held4-cycle blocks (two R1, four R3). For full,low,high subsets of held tones, both median and P90 projected spectral-norm residual must not exceed the fixed max of the corresponding two uncorrected R1-calibration blocks. Residuals must also not exceed the same-block STATIC residual (median/P90), and number of tones with any positive PCD change above the original floor must not increase. Require held proxy u within empty fit range (no extrapolation) and a valid fit. All conditions hold at every block. A model envelope pass is an engineering predictability check, not a confidence-calibrated false-alarm bound. Do not alter envelopes using R3held.
PCD_invariants: Keep exact original R1 two-half projected spectral-norm floor, dominance>=0.7, exactlyonepositive change mode, >=15full tones and >=8half-band tones, projected energy>=10%, 3dB ambiguity margin,9deg time/frequency/quarter checks. R1-calibration envelope controls model permission only; it never replaces the PCD eigenvalue floor.
human_branch: After empty decisions freeze, run NSI-PCD and NSD-PCD only if the same model passes everyrequired state of that arm. G2 uses G2_control; twelve uses allG1-G4/C1/C2 with original positive R1 weights. Same method, never per-site choosing NSI versusNSD. Inactive arms output blocked_by_empty_model with no fabricated angle. If allarmsfail, do not compute or score newlycorrected R2; retain baseline numerical comparison and per-site empty eligibility table. NSD is predeclared primary, NSI sensitivity.
human_validation_if_permitted: R2first12 predicts, later12 checks. R3fit0:8 is used for model parameters and cannot be treated as independent negative control. Only R3held8:24 supports post-fit empty checks. Scale proxy outside fitrange blocks output. Retain 864 packets/run budgets, disclose changed empty roles and do not portray old full-R3 validation as equivalent. Human truth is for later scoring only.
stop: One frozen two-model test. Do not enlarge empirical envelopes or refit after held results to increase output. A state/subarray passing alone does not establish a twelve-antenna output. If no model qualifies, conclude that empty stability remains unresolved and document minimal next conditions. Preserve old results and raw CSI.
